# EvE Waste

> EvE Waste LLC is a Columbus, Ohio company that transforms food waste into
> clean energy and nutrient-rich fertilizer using modular bio-reactors. The
> system runs on the natural, microbial process of anaerobic digestion.

Positioning is cost first: the bio-reactor processes food waste more affordably
than a landfill and derives more value from it. Sustainability is the second
argument, never the first.

## What the system does

Waste goes in, products come out. Food waste is broken down into digestate
while producing biogas. The digestate is processed into fertilizer, and the
biogas is converted into clean energy. The fertilizer is sold to agricultural
and landscaping sectors, and the clean energy reduces the client's energy bill.

The bio-reactor also contains AI waste tracking software that produces waste
reports. Clients use them to find additional savings upstream and to comply
with organic waste mandates.

## Figures, with their basis

Every figure below carries the basis it rests on. None of them are measured
customer results — EvE Waste has no clients yet.

- 19% — new economic value the process generates versus landfilling. Basis: modeled.
- 15% — average annual increase in landfill tipping and hauling rates. Basis: industry data.
- 5,000+ years — the span without an economical change in how we process waste. Basis: historical.

No throughput, footprint, retention time, biogas yield, methane content,
digestate output, utility connection or commissioning figures are published.
They are available on request under NDA.

## Feedstock

Accepted: all food waste. No refusal list is published.
